evidence.quote: I find it difficult to identify a single measure that doesn't show that inflation has drifted steadily lower.
the unemployment rate remains stubbornly close to its peak.
I believe that the expansion of securities holdings was worth implementing to support the economy and make the recovery more durable.
I believe that the actions taken by the FOMC to support the economic recovery are appropriate, and I am confident in our commitment to monitor economic conditions and take action as needed.
While we will need to remain alert to economic developments, I am convinced that we can and will manage these risks.

parsed.rationale: The speaker defends the $600 billion asset purchase program, stresses very low and declining inflation and painfully slow labor market improvement, and dismisses inflation risks from reserves. Some optimism about the recovery gaining traction and discussion of exit tools temper the dovish tone slightly.
